svg.title: STRATOS firmware state diagram (proposed)
svg.desc: Proposed payload firmware states, transitions and error handling. Design only; not implemented on hardware.
svg.text: Proposed design (firmware draft not yet run on hardware). 10 Hz record cycle; 1 Hz telemetry; SD flush once per second.
probe BME280, IMU, microSD, SX1276 radio
no data path (no SD and no radio)
beeper error code; retry in 5 s
append to RAM ring buffer (50 records)
• Any state → brown-out or watchdog reset → power-on/reset: a NEW session ID is issued and t_ms restarts at 0.
The payload has no real-time clock; absolute (UTC) time is added only by the ground station on reception.
A time discontinuity is therefore always visible as a session change in both the onboard log and the ground log.
• Background checks in READY every cycle: VBAT-low counter, cycle-time overrun (> 100 ms → CYCLE_OVERRUN flag),
pressure-based landing detector (altitude stable ±2 m for 60 s after ≥ 30 m descent → recovery beeper chirps).
• Logging never waits for the radio: records are buffered and written whether or not a packet is ever received.
STRATOS • Team Nothingburger • Rev A • proposed design
